prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web checkout concept, 1440x900 landscape
Input image: visual identity reference only—inherit its matte blush-cream and wine palette, typographic character, compact Lirios header, hairline rules, and tactile florist atmosphere; do not copy the catalog content or composition.
Primary request: Create the Lirios cart and cash-on-delivery checkout as one calm continuous workshop order sheet named “Hoja del taller”. This must look like a real designed desktop web surface, not a poster. The visitor’s job—review the cart, enter delivery details, and confirm the order—must be obvious in one glance.
Composition/framing: Exact 1440x900 desktop viewport. At the top, a compact existing-style Lirios header with burgundy Lirios wordmark at left, restrained navigation centered, and cart indicator at right. Below, create a disciplined three-column editorial checkout.
Left: a slim index rail with numbered entries “01 Carrito”, “02 Tus datos”, “03 Entrega”, “04 Confirmar”; show “01 Carrito” active with a subtle wine hairline rule.
Center: a broad main column titled “Tu pedido”. Show two editable cart rows, each with a small square real flower-product photo, the product name, price, minus / quantity / plus controls, and “Eliminar”. Product 1 is “Lirios carmesí”; product 2 is “Gerberas doradas”. Keep control labels sharply readable and align each row on horizontal hairline rules. Below the rows, show contact and delivery fields already visible as refined underlined fields—not cards—including useful Spanish labels such as “Nombre completo”, “Teléfono”, “Correo electrónico”, “Dirección de entrega”, “Municipio” and “Referencias”.
Right: a narrow sticky summary column titled “Resumen”. List “Subtotal”, “Entrega” with value “Por confirmar”, and “Total”; include “Pago contraentrega” as the sole payment method. End with a strong wine rectangular button labeled “Confirmar pedido”.
Style/medium: production-grade editorial florist ecommerce UI, calm continuous order sheet, precise grid, restrained luxury, generous but efficient whitespace. Square corners. Hairline rules. No panels masquerading as cards.
Typography: Bodoni Moda-style high-contrast serif for display title and product names; sober Manrope-style sans serif for controls, labels, prices and helper text.
Color palette: matte blush cream #faf2eb background, florist wine #6c1326 and #741429, charcoal #2d2427, blush #e8d1cc.
Photography: only two small real flower-product square thumbnails in the cart rows, aesthetically consistent with the reference—soft warm studio photography, woven or textile-like lilies and gerberas. No other imagery.
Exact prominent text, rendered verbatim and legibly: “Tu pedido”, “Carrito”, “Tus datos”, “Entrega”, “Pago contraentrega”, “Resumen”, “Confirmar pedido”.
Constraints: Spanish UI copy; structurally complete and believable; contact and delivery form visible within the first viewport; clear editable quantity controls; summary visible simultaneously; precise alignment; strong but calm hierarchy.
Avoid: fake delivery promises or timing claims, discounts, testimonials, rounded cards, rounded buttons, dashboard chrome, generic ecommerce styling, decorative illustrations, invented payment methods, credit-card fields, shadows, gradients, glass effects, pills, excessive borders, oversized hero copy, poster layout, any product photography beyond the two cart thumbnails.
